entities.name: African Bride Price (Lobola)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Lobola (bride price) requires the groom's family to pay cattle, goods, or money to the bride's family. Unlike dowry (which flows from bride's family to groom), lobola flows to the bride's family as compensation for her labor and fertility. It formalizes the bond between two families, not just two individuals.
